description: 银行流水为空（anti 右侧为空集）
ERP 一行收款单号为 NULL

mutate.erp: SELECT * FROM S UNION ALL SELECT NULL, DATE '2026-09-30', '测试客户', 100.0, NULL

description: 空集 + NULL 同时出现：银行为空且 ERP 有 NULL 单号（NULL NOT IN 空集 = TRUE）

mutate.erp: SELECT * FROM S UNION ALL SELECT NULL, DATE '2026-09-30', '测试客户', 100.0, NULL

description: 银行一行流水号为 NULL（收入>0）

mutate.bank: SELECT * FROM S UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-09-30', '测试客户', '无单号', 88.00, 0, 0, NULL

description: 并列：同一 AR 有两笔同日同额流水（take per 的确定性）

mutate.bank: SELECT * FROM S UNION ALL (SELECT 交易日期, 对方户名, 摘要, 收入金额, 支出金额, 余额, 流水号 || 'X' FROM S WHERE 摘要 LIKE '%AR%' ORDER BY 流水号 LIMIT 1)

description: 安全库存标准维键重复（门店+SKU 重复一行）

mutate.std: SELECT * FROM S UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM S ORDER BY 门店, SKU LIMIT 1)

mutate.stock: SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN SKU = (SELECT min(SKU) FROM S) THEN NULL ELSE 期末库存 END AS 期末库存) FROM S

description: 最新日期有 NULL 日期行

mutate.stock: SELECT * FROM S UNION ALL (SELECT * REPLACE (NULL AS 日期) FROM S LIMIT 2)

mutate.target: SELECT * FROM S UNION ALL (SELECT * FROM S ORDER BY ALL LIMIT 1)

mutate.east: SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN 门店 = (SELECT min(门店) FROM S) THEN NULL ELSE 区域 END AS 区域) FROM S

mutate.north: SELECT * REPLACE (CASE WHEN 门店 = (SELECT min(门店) FROM S) THEN 123456789012345.67 ELSE 销售额 END AS 销售额) FROM S

mutate.target: SELECT * REPLACE (0 AS 目标销售额) FROM S
